title: A quick recap
slide_intent: Teach how to identify the parts of a finished communication. Numbered cross-references let a reader trace a design choice from specimen to application.
strategic_value: A recognizable family of assets can support both expressive covers and report pages with substantial text.
demonstration: An upper strip catalogs the logo, strapline, colors, type, photography, illustration, marks and patterns. Numbered labels point to those elements in the printed pieces below.
practical_value: Identify the few assets a proposed piece needs by comparing it with the annotated covers and interior spread.

content_islands.name: Asset key
content_islands.spec: Arrange named specimens across the gray upper field and attach a small numbered marker to each asset class.

content_islands.name: Annotated applications
content_islands.spec: Line up the covers and open publication below. Place the same numbers near the features they identify, with fine leaders where useful.
